problem.summary: 现有深度CNN超分辨率模型未能充分利用原始低分辨率图像的层次化特征，导致性能相对较低。

motivation.summary: 层次化特征对图像恢复任务（如超分辨率）非常有用，但现有方法（如SRDenseNet、MemNet）在特征提取和融合上存在局限，未能完全利用所有卷积层的特征。

core_idea.summary: 提出残差密集网络（RDN），通过残差密集块（RDB）提取丰富的局部特征，并利用密集特征融合（DFF）自适应地学习全局层次化特征，从而充分利用所有卷积层的特征。

method.summary: RDN由浅层特征提取网络（SFENet）、多个残差密集块（RDBs）、密集特征融合（DFF）和上采样网络（UPNet）组成。RDB包含密集连接层、局部特征融合（LFF）和局部残差学习（LRL），实现连续记忆（CM）机制。DFF包括全局特征融合（GFF）和全局残差学习（GRL）。

experiments.summary: 在多个基准数据集（Set5、Set14、B100、Urban100、Manga109）上，使用三种退化模型（BI、BD、DN）进行实验，与多种先进方法（SRCNN、LapSRN、DRRN、SRDenseNet、MemNet、MDSR等）比较，通过PSNR/SSIM指标评估性能。

claims.claim: RDN通过充分利用层次化特征，在图像超分辨率任务中实现了优于现有方法的性能。
RDB的CM、LRL和GFF组件对性能提升有显著贡献。
RDN对不同退化模型和真实世界图像具有鲁棒性。
LFF允许更大的增长率（G），从而提升性能。
RDN使用L1损失函数比L2损失函数更有效。

limitations.limitation: 论文未明确讨论计算复杂度或推理时间；与MDSR相比，在较大缩放因子（×3、×4）下优势不明显，可能因网络深度、多尺度输入或训练补丁大小差异所致。

nodes.title: 浅层特征提取网络 (SFENet)
nodes.label: SFENet
nodes.summary: 从输入低分辨率图像中提取浅层特征，为后续RDB提供输入。
nodes.description: SFENet包含两个卷积层：第一层提取特征F_{-1}，第二层进一步提取特征F_0作为RDB的输入。

nodes.title: 残差密集块 (RDB)
nodes.label: RDB
nodes.summary: 通过密集连接卷积层提取局部特征，并利用连续记忆机制和局部残差学习增强信息流。
nodes.description: RDB包含C个密集连接的卷积层，每层输出G个特征图。通过局部特征融合（LFF）自适应融合特征，并利用局部残差学习（LRL）输出最终特征F_d。

nodes.title: 密集特征融合 (DFF)
nodes.label: DFF
nodes.summary: 融合所有RDB的层次化特征，通过全局特征融合和全局残差学习生成最终特征。
nodes.description: DFF包括全局特征融合（GFF）和全局残差学习（GRL）。GFF使用1×1和3×3卷积融合所有RDB输出的特征，GRL将浅层特征与GFF输出相加得到F_DF。

nodes.title: 上采样网络 (UPNet)
nodes.label: UPNet
nodes.summary: 将低分辨率空间特征上采样到高分辨率空间，生成最终超分辨率图像。
nodes.description: UPNet使用ESPCN进行上采样，后接一个卷积层输出3通道彩色图像。

nodes.title: 连续记忆机制 (CM)
nodes.label: CM
nodes.summary: 允许前一个RDB的状态直接连接到当前RDB的所有层，增强特征传递。
nodes.description: 通过将前一个RDB的输出F_{d-1}与当前RDB各层输出拼接，实现连续记忆。

nodes.title: 局部特征融合 (LFF)
nodes.label: LFF
nodes.summary: 在RDB内自适应融合前一个RDB和当前所有卷积层的特征，稳定宽网络训练。
nodes.description: 使用1×1卷积层融合拼接后的特征，控制输出信息。

nodes.title: 局部残差学习 (LRL)
nodes.label: LRL
nodes.summary: 在RDB内引入残差连接，进一步改善信息流和梯度传播。
nodes.description: 将RDB输入F_{d-1}与LFF输出F_{d,LF}相加，得到RDB最终输出F_d。

nodes.title: 全局特征融合 (GFF)
nodes.label: GFF
nodes.summary: 融合所有RDB输出的层次化特征，提取全局特征。
nodes.description: 使用1×1和3×3卷积层融合所有RDB输出的特征F_1到F_D。

nodes.title: 全局残差学习 (GRL)
nodes.label: GRL
nodes.summary: 将浅层特征与全局特征融合输出相加，增强特征表示。
nodes.description: 将浅层特征F_{-1}与GFF输出F_GF相加，得到密集特征F_DF。

edges.label: 特征拼接

deltas.before: SRDenseNet使用基本密集块，无连续记忆机制，局部特征融合不足，训练宽网络困难。
deltas.after: RDB引入连续记忆（CM）机制，允许前一个RDB状态直接连接到当前所有层；使用局部特征融合（LFF）自适应融合特征，稳定宽网络训练；引入局部残差学习（LRL）改善信息流。
deltas.why_it_matters: CM机制增强了特征传递和梯度流，LFF允许更大的增长率（G），LRL进一步改善信息流，从而提升性能并稳定训练。
L1损失函数在图像超分辨率中通常能产生更清晰的结果。

deltas.before: MemNet需要将原始LR图像插值到目标尺寸作为输入，增加计算复杂度并丢失细节。
deltas.after: RDN直接在LR空间提取特征，避免预处理步骤。
deltas.why_it_matters: 减少计算复杂度并保留原始LR图像细节。

deltas.before: 大多数深度CNN SR模型未充分利用层次化特征。
deltas.after: RDN通过密集特征融合（DFF）充分利用所有卷积层的层次化特征。
deltas.why_it_matters: 层次化特征对图像恢复任务非常有用，充分利用它们可以提升性能。

metadata.title: Residual Dense Network for Image Super-Resolution
metadata.venue: 2018 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
metadata.paper_type: Computer Vision / Pose Estimation / Computer Vision / CNN / Computer Vision / Top-cited Computer Vision paper
metadata.abstract: A very deep convolutional neural network (CNN) has recently achieved great success for image super-resolution (SR) and offered hierarchical features as well. However, most deep CNN based SR models do not make full use of the hierarchical features from the original low-resolution (LR) images, thereby achieving relatively-low performance. In this paper, we propose a novel residual dense network (RDN) to address this problem in image SR. We fully exploit the hierarchical features from all the convolutional layers. Specifically, we propose residual dense block (RDB) to extract abundant local features via dense connected convolutional layers. RDB further allows direct connections from the state of preceding RDB to all the layers of current RDB, leading to a contiguous memory (CM) mechanism. Local feature fusion in RDB is then used to adaptively learn more effective features from preceding and current local features and stabilizes the training of wider network. After fully obtaining dense local features, we use global feature fusion to jointly and adaptively learn global hierarchical features in a holistic way. Experiments on benchmark datasets with different degradation models show that our RDN achieves favorable performance against state-of-the-art methods.

3.2. Residual Dense Block Now we present details about our proposed residual dense block (RDB) in Fig. 3. Our RDB contains dense con- nected layers, local feature fusion (LFF), and local resid- ual learning, leading to a contiguous memory (CM) mecha- nism. Contiguous memory mechanism is realized by passing the state of preceding RDB to each layer of current RDB. LetFd−1 andFd be the input and output of the d-th RDB respectively and both of them have G 0 feature-maps. The output ofc-th Conv layer ofd-th RDB can be formulated as

[Fd−1,F d,1, · · ·,F d,c−1] refers to the concatenation of the feature-maps produced by the (d − 1)-th RDB, convolu- tional layers 1, · · ·, (c − 1) in the d-th RDB, resulting in

The outputs of the preced- ing RDB and each layer have direct connections to all sub- sequent layers, which not only preserves the feed-forward nature, but also extracts local dense feature. Local feature fusion is then applied to adaptively fuse the states from preceding RDB and the whole Conv layers in current RDB. As analyzed above, the feature-maps of the (d − 1)-th RDB are introduced directly to thed-th RDB in a concatenation way, it is essential to reduce the feature num- ber. Dense Feature Fusion After extracting local dense features with a set of RDBs, we further propose dense feature fusion (DFF) to exploit hierarchical features in a global way. Our DFF consists of global feature fusion (GFF) and global residual learning. Global feature fusion is proposed to extract the global featureFGF by fusing features from all the RDBs

where [F1, · · ·,F D] refers to the concatenation of feature- maps produced by residual dense blocks 1, · · ·,D . HGF F is a composite function of 1 × 1 and 3 × 3 convolution. The 1 × 1 convolutional layer is used to adaptively fuse a range of features with different levels. The following 3 × 3 convolutional layer is introduced to further extract features for global residual learning, which has been demonstrated to be effective in [14]. The ﬁnal Conv layer has 3 output channels, as we output color HR images. However, the network can also process gray images. 4. Discussions Difference to DenseNet. Inspired from DenseNet [7], we adopt the local dense connections into our proposed residual dense block (RDB). In general, DenseNet is widely used in high-level computer vision tasks (e.g., object recog- nition). While RDN is designed for image SR. Moreover, we remove batch nomalization (BN) layers, which consume the same amount of GPU memory as convolutional layers, increase computational complexity, and hinder performance of the network. We also remove the pooling layers, which could discard some pixel-level information. Furthermore, transition layers are placed into two adjacent dense blocks in DenseNet. While in RDN, we combine dense connected layers w...

in Section 5. As a result, the output of the (d − 1)-th RDB has direct connections to each layer in the d-th RDB and also contributes to the input of (d + 1)-th RDB. Last not the least, we adopt global feature fusion to fully use hierarchi- cal features, which are neglected in DenseNet. Difference to SRDenseNet. There are three main dif- ferences between SRDenseNet [31] and our RDN. The ﬁrst one is the design of basic building block. SRDenseNet in- troduces the basic dense block from DenseNet [7]. Our residual dense block (RDB) improves it in three ways: (1). We introduce contiguous memory (CM) mechanism, which allows the state of preceding RDB have direct access to
each layer of the current RDB. (2). Our RDB allow larger

growth rate by using local feature fusion (LFF), which sta- bilizes the training of wide network. (3). Local residual learning (LRL) is utilized in RDB to further encourage the ﬂow of information and gradient. The second one is there is no dense connections among RDB. Instead we use global feature fusion (GFF) and global residual learning to ex- tract global features, because our RDBs with contiguous memory have fully extracted features locally. As shown in Sections 5.2 and 5.3, all of these components increase the performance signiﬁcantly. The third one is SRDenseNet usesL2 loss function. Whereas we utilizeL1 loss function, which has been demonstrated to be more powerful for per- formance and convergence [17]. As a result, our proposed RDN achieves better performance than that of SRDenseNet. Difference to MemNet. Conclusions In this paper, we proposed a very deep residual dense network (RDN) for image SR, where residual dense block (RDB) serves as the basic build module. In each RDB, the dense connections between each layers allow full usage of local layers. The local feature fusion (LFF) not only stabi- lizes the training wider network, but also adaptively controls the preservation of information from current and preceding RDBs.
